title: Control Room Operator
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To


  • Production Supervisor

    • Background


  • A CRO is capable of operating DCS, Fire and Gas and ESD systems from Central Control Room. They will optimize the process and reduce and control plant upsets. They will respond effectively to emergencies. They will ensure that plant inhibits, and overrides are controlled as per procedures and Management System guidelines. They will ensure that that personnel under his supervision are fully competent and aware of their responsibilities.

    • Authority


  • The CRO is authorized to control and adjust the automated process safely to maximize production efficiency, and to coordinate permits and related isolations for maintenance.

    • Immediate Subordinates


  • Lead Production Technician, Production Technicians, Subcontractors, Vendors, Visitors.

    • Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards


  • 1) Process
  • 1 Start up, Operate, Monitor and Shut Down Process and Utility Systems.
  • 2 Monitor, maintain and optimize process parameters (Level, flow, temperature, pressure etc.) within operating requirements.
  • 3 Compare sample and testing results (API/BS &W/salinity) of process and utility fluids to optimal.
  • 4 Trouble shoot to maximize sales quality and delivery volume to identify problems.
  • 5 Maintain discharge water quality within current O &M Contractor Operations or local guidelines.
  • 6 Monitor and operate electrical/hydraulic control panels, safety and emergency shutdown devices, Fire and Gas Systems.
  • 7 Ensure accurate production reporting is submitted daily or as required by company and client.
  • 8 Witness third party calibrations when appropriate to provide verification of meter factors and volumes.
  • 9 Prove export oil meters.
  • 2) Marine/Safety
  • 1 Implementing and enforcing Management System policies and procedures in particular Isolation Standards, and PTW.
  • 2 Carry out all operations in safe and environmentally sound manner.
  • 3 Report all discharges, leaks, spills, injuries, and incidents, immediately.
  • 4 Ensure personnel understand and comply with current environmental regulations.
  • 5 Carry out Emergency Response role.
  • 3) Maintenance
  • 1 Assist maintenance operations by applying/removing isolations as required.
  • 2 Supervise operation of PTW system.
  • 3 Advise maintenance personnel on hazards of plant and equipment.
  • 4 Maintain clear and precise communications during maintenance operations.
  • 4) Manage & Supervise Effectively
  • 1 Coordinate activities and resources across teams or shift.
  • 2 Contribute to training and assessment of personnel.
  • 3 Control activities and development of subordinate personnel.
  • 4 Record and report on personnel development/appraisals and competence assessments as required.
  • 5 Efficiency improvement and pursue company goals.
  • 6 Create and maintain effective working relationships. 5) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

    • Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies


    Offshore - Handover Offshore - Emergency Response Offshore - P&ID Offshore - Safety Management - HOD Offshore - Plant Walk Through Offshore - Introduction to DCS Offshore - Stock monitoring Offshore - Communications Offshore - Permit-to-Work System

    Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience


  • Experience in Hydrocarbon processing operations with 1 year as CCRO and appropriate mix of operational and supervisory experience.
  • Offshore Personal Survival, Management of Major Emergencies, Medical certificates.
  • Good level of troubleshooting and operations knowledge including interpretation of P &IDs and C &E charts.
  • Extensive knowledge of offshore FPSO operations, including Production, Maintenance, Engineering and Safety.
  • Good working Knowledge of DCS and F &G systems operation.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of A2 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

title: Professor(a) de Matemática
description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA
A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) de Matemática para o Fundamental 2. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas dessa disciplina (esta é uma vaga temporária de licença maternidade).

RESPONSABILIDADES
O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas de Matemática alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.
REQUISITOS
O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Matemática;
  • Experiência com Fundamental 2.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída;
  • Inglês.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA
O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Visit our careers site for more information;

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
The Company
Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.
Located in Barra da Tijuca, Brazil
30 Hours Per Week - Monday - Friday
Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Build software that powers real‑world decisions. As a Software Development Intern, you'll contribute to production web applications across the stack—.NET Core and Python on the back end, React and jQuery on the front end—inside a collaborative culture that prizes innovation, performance, and scalability. Expect structured mentorship, meaningful ownership, and hands‑on experience with projects ranging from spatial data tools to specialized oil & gas solutions—think seismic and well data visualization/manipulation and web‑scraping pipelines—where advanced technology meets complex business challenges. If you're ready to learn fast, ship fast, and see your work make an impact, this is the opportunity.
Tasks:
Work with the development team to design, build, and maintain features across company applications using SQL, Java, .NET, Python, and JavaScript—leveraging frameworks such as React and jQuery.
Skills and Knowledge:
Analytical thinking – ability to break down problems into smaller components.
Understanding of algorithms – basic concepts like loops, conditionals, and data structures.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
Supervisory Responsibilities:
This position has no supervisory responsibilities.
Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:
This is an internship position with a workload of 6 hours per day, totaling 30 hours per week.
Activities may be performed at Katalyst's office or remotely, depending on availability and team coordination.
The work schedule is flexible within regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.), while respecting the 6-hour daily requirement.
Hybrid work model – three remote days and two on-site days per week.
Travel:
This position does not require travel. All work will be conducted in-office or virtually. If participation in an offsite meeting or company event is ever requested, Katalyst will cover or reimburse all related expenses in accordance with company policies and local regulations.
Required Education and Experience
Currently enrolled in a technology-related undergraduate program with at least one year remaining before graduation.

title: Coordenador Administrativo
description:
Sobre a vaga
Na M. Dias Branco, acreditamos que a qualidade de vida no trabalho e o desenvolvimento das pessoas são essenciais para o nosso sucesso. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos, bem-estar e um ambiente colaborativo, onde cada pessoa é valorizada. Quer crescer com a gente? Vem

Quem somos
Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Temos mais de 17 mil colaboradores, 21 unidades no Brasil, 1 no Uruguai e 28 centros de distribuição, que garantem nossa presença no Brasil e em mais de 40 países pelo mundo.

Nossa atuação e cultura
Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, por acreditarmos que ela impulsiona resultados e transformações. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados e reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual.

Missão do Cargo:
Coordenar e acompanhar as atividades das áreas administrativas, suprindo ao superior imediato com informações gerenciais para análises estratégicas e tomadas de decisões.

  • Acompanhar as despesas e demais indicadores da área administrativa, realizando reuniões periódicas com a sua equipe;
  • Apoiar no acompanhamento do dia a dia do refeitório local;
  • Mensurar a qualidade dos serviços prestados por empresas terceirizadas e a satisfação dos clientes internos e visitantes;
  • Apoiar na rotina operacional e nas demandas de RH, Adm de Pessoal, Compras, Financeiro e Recebimento fiscal e Logística, na ausência do Gerente dessas áreas na unidade;
  • Cumprir e garantir a execução dos requisitos de Segurança de Alimentos estabelecidos na empresa.

title: coordenador nutrição
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.
A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Planejar, coordenar e supervisionar serviços ou programas de nutrição e alimentação da coletividade no âmbito da saúde, desenvolvendo campanhas educativas e outras atividades correlatas, a fim de contribuir para a criação de hábitos e regimes alimentares adequados.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Superior Completo em Nutrição/ Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Nutrição em Pediatria, Nutrição em Materno Infantil, Nutrição Clínica, Nutrição Geriatria e Gerontologia, Nutrição em Fitoterapia Nutricional ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde / Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função.

title: Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world's best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez's Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people's lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do


You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a Retention Marketing Specialist within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

Requirements


What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like


Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

Benefits

Up to 40 hours weekly

About UN/COMMON


UN/COMMON has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, reflecting our people-driven approach to growth, innovation, and excellence.

description:

I. A Missão da Posição
O Especialista de Design (Shoes) possui um perfil híbrido, sendo responsável por todo o ciclo do calçado: desde a concepção criativa e estética (estilista) até a tradução técnica e funcional do produto (designer)2. Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance. Ele atua como o elo central entre o conceito criativo e o produto acabado, servindo como referência técnica e estética para o time.
II. Responsabilidades Principais
Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados.
Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance.
Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce.
Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio.
Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca.
Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.
III. Requisitos e Qualificações
Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios.
Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes.
Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores.
Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.
IV. Diferenciais
Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure.
Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design.
Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento.
Conhecimento em análise de dados de mercado voltados especificamente para o setor de calçados.

title: Business Development Manager, AMZL Hub Brazil
description:
Business Development Manager – Hub Delivery

The Business Development Manager will lead the growth, performance, and operational excellence of Amazon's Hub Delivery program across regions in Brazil. Managing a team of Channel Team Leads (CTLs), this leader drives network expansion, ensures delivery quality, and develops high-performing field teams. The role blends strategic planning with selective hands-on support to accelerate launches, resolve escalations, and maintain Amazon's high standards.

title: Senior Cost Controller
description:
Position: Senior Cost Controller
Location: Barra da Tijuca
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The Senior Cost Controller is responsible for ensuring accurate financial control, cost management, and compliance across business units, supporting operational performance and strategic decision-making, particularly within FPSO operations.
Key Responsibilities
Manage accounts receivable processes, including aging reports and timely customer collections;
Ensure accurate and timely posting of invoices and revenue entries;
Manage billing processes, ensuring charges are issued in accordance with signed contracts and agreements;
Ensure compliance with Brazilian withholding tax regulations and statutory requirements;
Support month-end and year-end closing activities;
Prepare and review monthly accruals and revenue reconciliations;
Review, analyze, and explain variances in monthly and quarterly management and vessel reports (ERP);
Ensure timely and reliable financial closing and statutory reporting;
Maintain, review, and improve accounting procedures, processes, and internal controls;
Ensure group reporting meets corporate, audit, and tax compliance requirements;
Liaise with operations and provide finance/accounting support to business units;
Resolve accounting and financial queries and support cross-functional activities as needed.
Requirements
Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in FPSO or offshore oil & gas operations;
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;
Fluent English;
Strong knowledge of financial controls, cost management, and Brazilian tax legislation;
Experience with IFS ERP is a strong advantage.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus
Private Pension Plan
Childcare Allowance
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds, including women, Bl.

title: Investor Operations Associate
description:
Join our team as an Associate within our Investor Services space, where you'll support the end-to-end delivery of investor-related operations across a range of fund structures. This role is well suited to someone who is detail-oriented, process-driven, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
You'll work closely with Investor Services, Fund Accounting, Middle Office and Compliance teams, supporting the full investor lifecycle — from onboarding and transaction processing through to reporting, payments and client query resolution.
What You'll Bring
Qualifications in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
Minimum 2 years' experience in fund administration, ideally within Investor Services
Strong understanding of AML/KYC requirements
Advanced Excel ability (Microsoft 365) and Teams
Experience using investor management systems or fund admin platforms
Strong attention to detail
Strong analytical skills with a process-improvement mindset
Where You'll Add Value
Investor Lifecycle Support
Guide investors through onboarding by reviewing submissions, validating information, and ensuring readiness for activation
Set up and maintain investor records within internal platforms, applying accuracy checks and internal standards
Actively resolve documentation shortfalls by engaging clients and internal compliance partners before issues impact transactions
Transaction Handling & Investor Deliverables
Process and verify investor activity across subscriptions, redemptions and related movements
Assess supporting documentation to confirm completeness and alignment with internal records
Compile and review investor-facing outputs prior to release
Assist with payment workflows by coordinating required approvals and submission steps
Deliver investor-related reporting within agreed timelines while maintaining clear supporting records
Ensure all actions, approvals and communications are clearly documented and traceable
Investor & Client Interaction
Provide responsive, professional support to investors and clients across day-to-day queries
Manage incoming requests across multiple communication channels and prioritise actions appropriately
Track progress and resolution of requests to ensure transparency and timely follow-up
Working in Partnership with Operations Teams
Collaborate with Fund Accounting and Middle Office colleagues to align investor activity with the NAV cycle
Support investigation and resolution of investor-related variances
Contribute to the accurate execution of capital events, distributions and transaction postings
Risk Awareness & Operational Discipline
Monitor payment activity and escalate irregular or sensitive items in line with internal escalation protocols
Assist in maintaining regulatory documentation required for investor due diligence and reporting obligations
Apply internal control standards consistently and support audit and compliance reviews
Keep records orderly and audit-ready to support governance and oversight processes

title: tecnico de hemoterapia
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.
A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Participa dos processos de trabalho de unidades hemoterápicas (bancos de sangue), atuando no ciclo do sangue e em procedimentos de infusão de hemocomponentes e derivados para fins terapêuticos.
Realiza os processos de captação e triagem clínica de doadores de sangue.
Realiza a coleta e o processamento do sangue, o controle do armazenamento e da expedição e as provas sorológicas.
Recebe, prepara e processa amostras biológicas sanguíneas e auxilia as equipes de saúde nos procedimentos hemoterápicos.
Atua no controle da qualidade de reagentes, produtos, insumos e equipamentos.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Técnico Completo em Hemoterapia
Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovadas na área.

title: Petroleum Economics Analyst, Latin America
description:
About The Role:
Grade Level (for internal use):
10
About The Role:
The Petroleum Economics Analyst, Latin America functions as a member of the Vantage Asset Valuation team, providing expert fiscal, economic and financial analysis of upstream assets in Latin America for a wide-ranging customer base. You will become a subject matter expert on oil and gas fiscal modelling, working alongside a global team of experienced researchers and engineers. You will build your knowledge around the wider upstream industry as it, and S&P Global, adapts and evolves with the energy expansion . You'll be a key contact for fiscal research and economic modelling in your region for both internal and external customers.
The Team:
CERA Upstream Solutions at S&P Global Energy comprise some of the most extensive and complete information, analytics, insight, and advisory services in the world. We deliver oil and gas databases and software, energy transition, energy supply and demand forecasts, and comprehensive data on transactions at the global and regional market levels.
Responsibilities And Impact:
Be the go-to individual for fiscal research and economic analysis with thought-provoking, qualitative and quantitative deliverables in the form of excel based models, written reports and presentations. Ensure that the breadth of coverage of Vantage fiscal models covers all types of locations and properties.
Develop stand-alone project level as well as portfolio and company level consolidated cash flow models.
Respond to customer questions of various complexity in assigned geographical regions by providing deep subject matter expertise, timely insight, and good judgement.
Work in close co-operation with colleagues in publishing exciting and timely content.
Collaborate with product management teams to help define what type of results and analysis customers want to see and contribute to the continual development of the Vantage product and its relevant functionality.
Provide expert support to commercial teams, management, and colleagues for the marketing of the Vantage product to contribute to securing and retaining customers.
Continuously develop expertise in a particular practice or focus area and expand knowledge into related fields. Stay abreast of current/hot topics and contribute to written/published products to broaden and build upon subject matter knowledge.
What We're Looking For:
Basic Required Qualifications:
At least a bachelor's degree or studies towards a chartered qualification in economics, finance, tax, accountancy or law is a must. An equivalent combination of experience and education will be considered.
Hands-on experience of constructing, modifying, and reviewing Excel based DCF models (including key financial metrics), ideally of oil and gas upstream and midstream assets.
Experience with / ability to extract fiscal, financial and economic / commercial information from contracts, legislation, etc. and quantify it in the economic models; knowledge of oil and gas upstream fiscal terms / contracts and broader petroleum economics.
Native/Fluent Portuguese Speaker
Additional Preferred Qualifications:
Expert level proficiency in Excel.
Demonstrated proficiency in functional programming (preferably F#), applying best practices, and producing clean, unit‑tested, maintainable code in a collaborative production environment.
Data analytics tools such as SQL, python, R, or other programming languages knowledge is a plus.
Experience in a similar role and with an oil and gas operator, reserves auditor, consulting, advisory or financial institution.
About S&P Global Energy
At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.
S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive economically in a rapidly changing global landscape. Learn more at

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. title: Gerente de Midia
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We're a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we've grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, Voltaren, Theraflu, Otrivin, and Centrum – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
Now it's time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Olá. Nós somos Haleon.

Uma nova empresa líder mundial em saúde do consumidor, moldada por todos que se juntam a nós. Juntos, estamos melhorando a saúde cotidiana de bilhões de pessoas. Estamos crescendo e inovando nosso portfólio global de marcas líderes de categoria – incluindo Sal de fruta Eno, Sonrisal, Sensodyne, Advil, Corega e Centrum – através de uma combinação única de compreensão humana profunda e ciência confiável. Somos uma empresa na qual estamos no controle, em um ambiente que estamos co-criando, numa cultura que é única.
Gostaria de se juntar a nós?

Head de Mídia Brasil

Estamos à procura de um Head de Mídia Brasil para Co-liderar com a equipe de Marketing as combinações de marca e mercado atribuídas, com insumos estratégicos, implementação de campanhas, transformação digital e medição de desempenho das campanhas. .

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Implementar os valores agregados atribuídos às principais combinações de marca e mercado provenientes das negociações digitais com fornecedores-chave como Google e Facebook.
  • Conduzir e implementar a agenda de testes e aprendizados conforme os objetivos de mídia definidos no início de cada ano, alinhados à visão global e aos objetivos de negócios do Diretor de Marketing da Latam. Iterar e aprender com essas hipóteses e testes.
  • Co-liderar com o Gerente de Mídia Latam e Head o processo de planejamento de conexões para combinações-chave de marca e mercado.
  • Implementar a estratégia de audiência full funnel e atualizar, otimizar e capturar aprendizados em toda a LATAM.
  • Co-liderar com equipes locais de marketing e atualizar mensalmente os fluxos de mídia local Haleon.
  • Impulsionar inovação em mídia nas marcas atribuídas, garantindo que aproveitemos ao máximo as possibilidades dos fornecedores e as necessidades das marcas (patrocínios, ações especiais na TV), trabalhando de forma transversal com outras áreas como Marketing, Trade, Comex, Analytics e Insights, entre outras.
  • Trabalhar de perto com Insights, Analytics e outras fontes de dados (Brand Lifts, MMMs) para criação de insights a partir da coleta de dados das marcas atribuídas.
  • Criar relatórios trimestrais de desempenho das principais combinações de marca e mercado para apresentar ações que possam melhorar o desempenho das campanhas aos Diretores de Marketing. (Reuniões mensais pós-compra com a agência de mídia devem ser lideradas pelas equipes locais de Marketing, exceto no Brasil, onde o Coordenador de Mídia local fará essa tarefa).

Requisitos:

  • Bacharelado em Marketing, Estatística, Matemática, Economia ou área relacionada.
  • Experiência em marketing ou mídia, preferencialmente em ambiente de bens de consumo ou agência.
  • Capacidade comprovada de traduzir análises complexas em insights claros e acionáveis.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para compartilhar insights e recomendações com stakeholders internos.

Se sente que esse é seu próximo passo de carreira, inscreva-se até 21 /11/2025

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão

Na Haleon, abraçamos nossa força de trabalho diversificada, criando um ambiente inclusivo que celebra nossas perspectivas únicas, gera curiosidade para criar uma compreensão incomparável uns dos outros e promove resultados justos e equitativos para todos.  

Estamos nos esforçando para criar um clima onde celebremos nossa diversidade em todas as formas, tratando uns aos outros com respeito, ouvindo diferentes pontos de vista, apoiando nossas comunidades e criando um local de trabalho onde seu eu autêntico pertença e prospere.  
Acreditamos em uma cultura de trabalho ágil para todas as nossas funções. Se a flexibilidade for importante para você, recomendamos que explore com nossa equipe de contratação quais são as oportunidades.   

Care to join us. Find out what life at Haleon is really like 

 Job Posting End Date

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It's important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees. 
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We'll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence. 

Note to candidates

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account ). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Sr
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior de CRM (Salesforce) para atuar como Líder Técnico de Squad, garantindo a excelência das entregas e a evolução técnica da equipe.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar tecnicamente uma squad responsável pelo desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções Salesforce;
  • Garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, padrões de código e qualidade das entregas;
  • Apoiar a definição de soluções técnicas e participar ativamente da estimativa e planejamento de sprints;
  • Desenvolver customizações complexas em Apex, LWC, Visualforce e Flows;
  • Atuar na integração da plataforma com sistemas internos e externos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada com Salesforce;
  • Certificação Salesforce Platform Developer I (desejável) e Platform Developer II (desejável);
  • Habilidade de liderança técnica e facilitação de equipe;
  • Domínio de Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce e automações nativas;
  • Conhecimento avançado do modelo de dados Salesforce e boas práticas de arquitetura;
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST/SOAP;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD.

Informações adicionais

E tem mais, confira o nosso pacote de benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico – Bradesco – extensivo a dependentes
  • PAE - Auxílio financeiro oferecido no caso de dependentes filhos(as) e/ou enteados(as) com deficiência intelectual
  • Convênio Farmácia . Descontos de até 85%
  • Previdência Complementar – Plano FlexPrev - variando de 1% a 11%, de acordo com o salário
  • Seguro de Vida – seguro para todos os colaboradores a partir da data de admissão, sem participação.
  • Extensão das Licenças - Maternidade (total de 180 dias) e Paternidade (total de 20 dias).
  • Vale-Alimentação e/ou Refeição – Caju Benefícios
  • Auxílio-Educacional - Para dependentes até o ensino médio.
  • TotalPass
  • Assinatura Solar - Possibilidade de obter desconto especial na conta de energia a partir da adesão a um plano de geração distribuída.
  • Clube Smiles Corporativo - Descontos de até 50% nos planos oferecidos para você planejar suas viagens. Disponível também para cônjuge e filhos 18+.
  • Adicional por tempo de serviço – Oferecemos ao colaborador um adicional de salário (de acordo ao tempo de casa) a ser pago por ocasião de férias.

E para o desenvolvimento de nossas equipes...

  • Plataforma de Aprendizagem: Trilha dos valores vibra e curadoria renomada com mais de 200 opções de cursos disponíveis para acesso a qualquer tempo.
  • Recrutamento Interno: Divulgação das vagas disponíveis em todo Brasil, incentivando a mobilidade interna.

Quem Somos?

Somos a Vibra, uma empresa jovem que já nasceu grande, uma das cinco maiores empresas do Brasil, com uma base de investidores diversificada e global. Com mais de 50 anos de experiência e um time competente e comprometido, atendemos mais de 30 milhões de pessoas que passam nos nossos mais de 8000 postos, por meio de nossos revendedores de norte a sul do país; e 26 mil clientes empresariais.

Aqui, temos ritmo na entrega de resultados e respeito nas relações. Escutamos com empatia e entregamos com agilidade. Agimos com protagonismo e colaboramos para fazer acontecer. Falamos com transparência, agimos com integridade e cumprimos os combinados.

title: Football Operations Specialist
description:
By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at

THE ROLE:

Football Operations Specialists are critical to the successful delivery of Genius Sports' officiating and officiating technology services. Operating in live match environments, you will work closely with qualified match officials and Genius Sports leadership to ensure flawless execution before, during, and after each fixture.

You will be trusted to perform under pressure, apply expert knowledge of football and technology, and uphold the highest operational standards in a competition followed by millions worldwide.

This is a part-time contract position where we anticipate the engagement will be for an initial 2 year. You will be paid on a per-match fee basis, with additional paid training hour

Matchday Operations

  • Operate football officiating technology systems during live Brasileirão fixtures.
  • Work directly alongside match officials, supporting decision-making through accurate, timely, and clear technical execution.
  • Identify, retrieve, and present the best possible camera angles and operational outputs in real time.
  • Maintain constant situational awareness during live play, where timing and precision are critical.

Pre-Match Preparation

  • Plan and manage all pre-match operational activities, typically beginning up to three hours before kick-off.
  • Conduct comprehensive system, hardware, and software checks to ensure full readiness.
  • Verify calibration, configuration, and operational integrity in line with Genius Sports SOPs.

Performance Monitoring & Issue Escalation

  • Monitor system performance throughout the match, proactively identifying anomalies or risks.
  • Independently troubleshoot technical issues in high-pressure environments.
  • Escalate issues clearly and professionally to senior operational leadership when required.

Post-Match Duties

  • Complete detailed post-match reports aligned with Genius Sports and CBF requirements.
  • Clip and document relevant match situations to support quality assurance, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to operational feedback loops to enhance future performance.

Operational Excellence & Development

  • Apply and uphold Standard Operating Procedures consistently across all assignments.
  • Contribute to training sessions and scenario-based simulations as part of ongoing development.
  • Support the development of best practices as the partnership with CBF evolves.

What you'll bring:

    • Strong Football Knowledge: Excellent understanding of football, match dynamics, and the Laws of the Game. Prior exposure to officiating environments is highly advantageous.
    • Composure Under Pressure: Proven ability to perform in live match environments where decisions are time-critical and highly scrutinised.
    • Technical Proficiency: Confident working with technology systems, with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues independently.
    • Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to preparation, execution, and reporting.
    • Clear Communication: Professional, calm, and precise communication style, particularly under pressure.
    • Self-Motivated & Accountable: Comfortable working independently as a contractor while representing Genius Sports and CBF to the highest standard.
    • Flexibility: Willingness to work evenings, weekends, and irregular hours aligned to the Brasileirão match calendar, including travel as required.
    Language Skills: Portuguese and English required

Contract & Working Model

  • This is a contractor role, paid on a per-match fee basis, with additional paid training hours.
  • Assignments will be scheduled according to competition needs and operational readiness.
  • Contractors will be expected to meet defined performance and availability standards throughout the season.

We enjoy an 'office-first' culture and maximize opportunities to collaborate, connect and learn together. Our hybrid working models differ depending on your role and location.

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we're committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports.

One team, being brave, driving change

We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius .

Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

Requisitos Obrigatórios Para a Posição

Somos uma empresa líder em vendas, montagem e manutenção de câmaras frigoríficas e distribuição de peças para o segmento de condicionadores de ar. No Grupo Clima Rio também oferecemos soluções completas em sistemas de climatização de ambientes, refrigeração comercial, refrigeração automotiva e energia solar. Ao todo, são mais de 30 categorias de produtos disponíveis no site, televendas, aplicativo ou em uma das nossas 29 lojas.
Contamos com uma estrutura de lojas distribuídas entre os estados do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Goiás, Distrito Federal, Minas Gerais, Espírito Santo, Rio Grande do Sul, Ceará, Bahia, Pernambuco, Santa Catarina e Paraíba. Além de 5 centros de distribuição e um time de mais de 1200 funcionários.

title: AZZAS 2154 / GRUPO SOMA | Analista de Comércio Exterior I | Operações
description:
No universo do GRUPO SOMA o que nos move é SONHAR GRANDE E FAZER GIGANTE. E como fazê-lo sem pensar no mercado global?

Se você deseja casar a experiência de trabalhar com Comércio Exterior com o senso de dono e de pertencimento a maior empresa de moda do Brasil aqui é o lugar

Nesta vaga você terá a responsabilidade de interagir com as principais marcas do Grupo e com a área de Operações para garantir a melhor experiência de importação para as marcas, atendendo aos seus calendários e gerando ganhos para CIA.

Além disso, você fará parte do time de Procurement, que vem revolucionando a visão de negociação e compras da companhia, além de ser um espaço extremamente colaborativo e de foco no desenvolvimento pessoal. Porque a final, GENTE É O QUE SOMA.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Efetuar abertura e acompanhamento dos processos de importação, solicitar os devidos pagamentos e realizar a prestação de contas dos processos finalizados junto ao financeiro da CIA
  • Realizar orçamentos de compra para as áreas e propor melhor estratégia de embarque e consolidação a ponto de preservar o markup/margem da coleção
  • Orçar e contratar melhor custo de frete vs. melhor serviço, preservando orçamento inicialmente realizado ou até Manter- se informado sobre a legislação do comercio, atualizando as áreas envolvidas em aspectos que possam afetar o processo de importação
  • Abrir, monitorar, instruir e acompanhar o embarque no exterior e o processo de nacionalização; o desembaraço aduaneiro juntamente com o despachante; coordenar liberações de importação junto aos órgãos reguladores e agendamento de entrega junto à transportadora e equipe de logística
  • Identificação de oportunidades de aumento da representatividade do produto importado na CIA por meio da busca por melhores custos e manutenção do nível de serviço nas entregas
  • Ter foco total nas marcas e em suas demandas. Acompanhar os calendários das marcas tanto para matéria prima quanto para produto acabado; gerar follow constante para a marca, engajando a confiabilidade deles em nossa operação; muni-los de informação sobre oportunidades de melhora no nível de serviço / aumento de margem para CIA para que possam tomar as melhores decisões quanto ao recebimento e consequente venda

Desenvolver constantemente o sistema de informes no Power BI, buscando a melhoria contínua e novas informações para gestão dos trabalhos relacionados;

Gerir projetos para novas soluções informáticas, participando de reuniões como os stakeholders e time do projeto;

Preparar e emitir ata de reuniões bem como os relatórios relacionados ao tema da das mesmas.

Gerir as certificações para pagamento dos fornecedores;

Elaborar relatório que consolide as informações da Unidade de Garantia de Qualidade e Normativa mensalmente em modelo previamente aprovado pelo gestor Naturgy;
Garantir o cumprimento de metas e objetivos estabelecidos pelo responsável do contrato que estejam relacionadas com as atividades;
Emitir relatórios semanal e mensal das atividades realizadas para certificação;
Promover e participar de reuniões para atendimento da atividade, sejam com áreas internas da Naturgy ou Órgãos Externos;
Preparar e emitir ata de reuniões bem como os relatórios relacionados ao tema da das mesmas.

The Consultant (Gender Safety Audit Workshops) reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Juiz de Fora, MG, Brazil

Expected duration

Four (4) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. The "Weaving the city: planning with a participatory approach" project is another phase of the "Territories of Citizenship" project, a partnership between the Municipality of Juiz de Fora and UN-Habitat, launched in December 2021. It applied the Quick Participatory Mapping (QPM) methodology across 139 Special Zones of Social Interest (ZEIS) and two rural districts, alongside the development of a comprehensive Socioeconomic Profile of the prioritized areas. In 2023 and 2024, this project was expanded with the creation of the Public Policy Observatory, a platform dedicated to local data production and analysis to support evidence-based decision-making, enhance transparency, and align municipal policies with global sustainable development goals. In 2026, "Weaving the city: planning with a participatory approach" will focus on improving the quality of life of Juiz de Fora's urban area by promoting inclusive public spaces, sustainable practices, and the integration of gender and diversity perspectives. The initiative also aims to strengthen local capacities for the formulation and monitoring of public policies aligned with global sustainable development agendas, while expanding social participation and community engagement in urban management. To properly implement the project and UN-Habitat's mandate in Brazil, a Consultant (Gender Safety Audit Workshops) is required to plan, coordinate and implement the UN-Habitat "Woman City" methodology in one (01) selected territory in Juiz de Fora. The "Woman City" methodology is composed of participatory gender safety audit workshops with women and girls in the selected territory. The consultant will be responsible for facilitating these participatory gender safety audit workshops with women and girls and for delivering a consolidated urban safety diagnosis, including practical and context-sensitive recommendations. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Consultant (Gender Safety Audit Workshops) reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Consultant (Gender Safety Audit Workshops) will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Develop a detailed work plan aligning with the project's schedule. b) Learn about the "Woman City" methodology to propose adaptations to the processes, questionnaires and other necessary materials. c) Develop and provide supporting documents and materials to facilitate participatory activities. d) When necessary, organize and carry out field trips to the territories for participatory activities. e) Organize and facilitate workshops, discussions, and other participatory dynamics with community and stakeholders, with the support of the UN-Habitat team ensuring alignment with project timelines and objectives. f) Maintain a well-organized and accessible file system for all collected data (interviews, surveys, observations, workshops). g) Assist in developing a georeferenced database for organizing public space information. h) Participate in other key participatory activities and meetings, as necessary. i) Present findings to local partners for validation, summarizing results, proposals, and recommendations for urban interventions. j) Develop urban safety strategies based on Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design (CPTED), and gender perspectives, aligned with the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the New Urban Agenda. l) Integrate gender perspectives throughout the project. m) Ensure continuous communication with UN-Habitat and stakeholders for coordination and updates. n) Develop reports following ABNT guidelines, ensuring alignment with UN-Habitat's quality standards and project requirements. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Consultant (Gender Safety Audit Workshops) shall assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Implementation and Methodological Framework Description: The Product 1 must contain (i) a detailed work plan including a timeline and a roadmap for the execution of the Urban Safety Perceptions Assessment Report, outlining the key activities, objectives, methodologies, deliverables, and suggested required resources (e.g.: materials, maps, equipment); (ii) a design of the data collection instruments, including a questionnaire proposal for the Participatory Safety Perception Survey, guided by CPTED principles; (iii) a proposal for the adaptation of the "Woman City" methodology, considering territorial contexts; (iv) methods for documenting interviews, workshop discussions, observations and outcomes; and (v) methods for data analysis and interpretation of results. Additionally, while detailing the methodologies, it is important to consider that the data generated for the Participatory Safety Perception Survey must be georeferenced. Expected delivery date: 15 days after signing the contract. Product 2 – Urban Safety Perceptions Assessment Report Description: The Product 2 must contain: (i) a description of the methodologies applied in the Participatory Safety Perception Survey and the "Woman City" methodology; (ii) a comprehensive research and analysis of both qualitative and quantitative data regarding the socio-territorial conditions of the area selected by the municipality; (iii) a systematization of the information collected — including participant profiles (age, race, gender, etc.), safety perceptions, and other outcomes from the participatory activities; and (iv) an evidence and data-based analysis of the key findings, highlighting the main socio-spatial factors and local dynamics influencing public safety perceptions in the selected territories. Additionally, a PPT presentation and an Executive Summary must be delivered, summarizing the general content of the product. The data, information, perceptions, and other results that make up the Urban Safety Perceptions Assessment Report will be derived from the implementation of the "Woman City" methodology (which includes participatory workshops). Expected delivery date: 60 days after signing the contract. Product 3 – Urban Security and Prevention Strategies Report Description: The Product 3 must contain: (i) a set of strategic recommendations to enhance urban safety, aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), including urban planning and/or design interventions guided by CPTED principles, as policy measures for violence prevention; (ii) proposals for integrating the findings into Juiz de Fora's urban planning strategies; and (iii) a roadmap for implementing the recommendations, outlining short, medium, and long-term actions, objectives, key stakeholders, and necessary resources. Additionally, a PPT presentation and an Executive Summary must be delivered, summarizing the key findings, proposals, and recommendations. The recommendations and proposals must be aligned with the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the New Urban Agenda, while also integrating a gender perspective to promote safer and more inclusive urban environments. Expected delivery date: 90 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Sociology, Anthropology, Public Policy, Urbanism or related fields is required.
• Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Social Science, Urban Planning, Geography, Public Policy, Gender Studies or related fields is required, or additional four (04) years of relevant technical experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Desirable:
• Additional training or certifications in gender-sensitive urban planning, human rights-based approaches, public safety policies or related fields is desirable. Work experience:
• Minimum of six (6) years of experience in participatory urban planning, urban safety, crime prevention, gender-sensitive urban planning, community-based safety initiatives or related fields is required.
• Experience in facilitating participatory processes, stakeholder engagement, and con-ducting community-based research is required.
• Experience in data collection, qualitative and quantitative research, and the systematization of socio-spatial information is desirable.
• Experience in planning, design, and/or working in informal settlements is desirable. Skills:
• Strong ability to conduct and document participatory workshops, interviews, and focus groups is required.
• Excellent writing and analytical skills to produce reports, research documents, and presentations are required.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and web search engines is required.
• Good command of geographical information systems (GIS) software (e.g., QGIS, MapInfo, ArcGIS) is desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of Spanish and English is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. • Payment 2 (30%): Upon delivery and approval of Product 2 (BRL:

The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted in the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. Descrição do emprego

Na Doctoralia, buscamos um líder com energia, visão estratégica e forte orientação por dados para coordenar nosso time de pré-vendas outbound. A pessoa será responsável por garantir a eficiência da jornada dos nossos leads, com foco em performance e excelência operacional.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar um time de 4 a 6 SDRs, promovendo desenvolvimento contínuo e foco em alta performance;
  • Garantir a eficiência da operação outbound, desde o lead MQL até a qualificação e agendamento de reuniões;
  • Monitorar indicadores críticos como conversão, tempo de resposta, volume por canal e no-show;
  • Revisar fluxos de cadência, roteiros e abordagens de contato, propondo melhorias com base em dados;
  • Realizar escutas, feedbacks, treinamentos e roleplays com o time;
  • Atuar de forma estratégica com Marketing, Vendas e áreas de suporte para otimizar o funil de qualificação;
  • Propor melhorias de processos e fluxos comerciais, com base em dados e performance do time;
  • Garantir a integração e evolução dos novos SDRs, fortalecendo cultura de aprendizado contínuo;
  • Ser ponte entre o time de pré-vendas e demais áreas, como Marketing, Vendas e Operações;
  • Utilizar ferramentas como Salesforce e Outreach para gestão de performance e automação.

Você vai se conectar com...

  • Gerente de Pré-Vendas (liderança direta)
  • Executivos de Vendas, Marketing, RevOps e TA
  • Outras lideranças da área comercial

Qualificações

O que buscamos

  • Experiência sólida com liderança de times SDR ou vendas;
  • Vivência prática liderado times em operações outbound B2B;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão com base em dados;
  • Boa comunicação, poder de influência e espírito de colaboração;
  • Conhecimento em CRM e ferramentas de automação (Salesforce, Outreach, etc.);
  • Formação superior completa.

Diferenciais que somam pontos

  • Já ter atuado como SDR antes de assumir a liderança;
  • Experiência em empresas SaaS, tech ou startups;
  • Ter estruturado processos de pré-vendas do zero;

Etapas do processo seletivo

  1. Triagem de currículos - analisamos seu perfil com base nos requisitos da vaga e no momento atual da área.
  2. Entrevista com Talent Acquisition (por vídeo) - bate-papo por vídeo com nosso time de Recrutamento para conhecer suas experiências, avaliar competências e entender o fit com a cultura. Também é sua oportunidade de tirar dúvidas e conhecer mais sobre a empresa
  3. Avaliação Comportamental - aplicamos um teste rápido (5 a 7 min) que nos ajuda a entender melhor seu perfil comportamental.
  4. Entrevista com a Liderança - conversa mais aprofundada com sua liderança direta. Avaliamos aspectos técnicos, expectativas e seguimos aprofundando o alinhamento com a vaga.

    Você será avaliado(a) pela Gerente de Pré-Vendas (liderança direta), pelo time de People e pelo Head B2B.
  6. Oferta e início imediato - Tudo certo? Seguimos com a proposta formal e, após a sua aprovação, você já poderá iniciar com a gente

Em todas as etapas fornecemos o feedback do processo.

title: Game Penetration Tester
description:
Cyrex, a Magic Media company, is a media and tech start-up powered by creativity and innovation. We work with leading developers and publishers in the games industry, providing support and solutions designed around individual needs and carried out by global experts.
We produce high-quality results by constantly staying at the forefront of modern technology and cutting-edge processes and practices. The best of our team are known for their strong initiative, not just in taking care of their day-to-day responsibilities but in helping identify ways to build, grow, and do more in their work.
We're currently looking for a dynamic addition to the team to help work on exciting cybersecurity and development projects for the video games industry. The ideal candidate will work with cross-functional teams to develop critical products and services for our clients and offer excellent technical support to our teams. If you're an enthusiastic, motivated, and lateral thinker, our team is waiting to meet you
This is a full-time position. The role requires strong low-level technical skills, such as C++ programming, working with network protocols, or reverse engineering. If your experience is mainly in web hacking, you should instead apply for the on-demand penetration testing position, which focuses more on web security.
Responsibilities
Perform penetration tests on PC, mobile, and console games
Reverse engineer game binaries and network protocols to identify vulnerabilities
Bypass client-side protections (SSL pinning, anti-cheat, packing/obfuscation)
Develop and maintain internal tools and PoCs (C++, Python)
Requirements
5+ years in penetration testing, reverse engineering or security research
Strong modern C++ and Python experience
Networking: TCP/UDP fundamentals (fragmentation, sequencing, multiplexing) and protocol design/mapping. Experience with Wireshark, mitmproxy and Scapy
Data/crypto basics: endianness, checksums, hashing, encoding, encryption/signing, bitmasks
Serialization: binary formats and var-length encodings
Binary exploitation (practical): crash triage, UAF/OOB/heap/stack, info leaks, ROP/JOP
Minimal RE capability: read disassembly when needed; use IDA/Ghidra and x64dbg/WinDbg/LLDB to support testing (deep reversing not required)
Basic web hacking knowledge
Working knowledge of
Unreal Engine (UE4/UE5, UE4SS), Unity, dnSpy, il2cpp
Benefits
An opportunity to hone and improve your skills by applying them to a diverse variety of gaming projects
The chance to work closely with a team of like-minded creative professionals in a fast-paced, multicultural environment on a variety of gaming projects
A competitive salary
Ongoing training and professional self-improvement opportunities
If this sounds interesting to you and you'd like to be at the forefront of cybersecurity, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
Descrição da Vaga:
Modelagem Financeira e Avaliação Econômica (VPL/TIR)

· Análise de Sensibilidade e Cenários: Avaliar como variações em premissas (ex: preço de energia, inflação, variação cambial) impactam o Valor Presente Líquido (VPL) e a Taxa Interna de Retorno (TIR).
· Apoio a Decisões de Investimento: Elaborar o racional financeiro para a aprovação de novos projetos, garantindo que o WACC (Custo Médio Ponderado de Capital) esteja corretamente aplicado.
Ciclo Orçamentário e Controle de Custos por Projeto
· Elaboração do Budget/Forecast: Liderar o planejamento financeiro anual e revisões trimestrais, garantindo que cada projeto tenha recursos alocados conforme o cronograma físico.
· Análise de Variação (Actual vs. Budget): Identificar desvios entre o orçado e o realizado, explicando os "porquês" (atrasos em obras, aumento de custos de materiais, etc.).
· Gestão de CAPEX: Monitorar o desembolso de capital para garantir que o projeto não sofra com falta de liquidez ou estoure o orçamento aprovado.
Automatização de Processos e BI
· Excel Avançado e Integração de Dados: Sólidos conhecimentos em excel e uso intensivo de ferramentas de automatização como Power Query para consolidar bases de dados de diferentes fontes (ERP, cronogramas de engenharia, planilhas auxiliares).
· Implementação de Dashboards: Criar ferramentas visuais (Power BI ou afins) que permitam o acompanhamento em tempo real dos KPIs financeiros dos projetos.
· Redução de Erro Humano: Substituir processos manuais por rotinas automatizadas, liberando tempo para a análise crítica em vez do preenchimento de planilhas. O candidato que souber operar em VBA terá um diferencial
Reporting Executivo e Storytelling
· Elaboração do Deck Mensal: Criar apresentações executivas que sintetizem a performance financeira, os riscos e as oportunidades.
· Tradução de IFRS para Gestão: Ajustar os números contábeis para uma visão gerencial, garantindo que a diretoria entenda o impacto de normas como o IFRS 16 (arrendamentos) ou IFRS 9 nos resultados dos projetos.
· Storytelling de Dados: Explicar a narrativa por trás dos números
